company.description:
G42 is an artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud computing company that provides solutions in various industries. G42’s platforms and industry solutions harness the latest scientific research and apply it in responsible ways. 

G42 is driving change in the region and beyond, joining forces with nations, corporations, and individuals to create the infrastructure for tomorrow’s world – with technology that goes beyond to give its partners the edge. From molecular medicine to space travel and everything in between, G42 realizes exponential possibilities, today.
